meaning: the entity is one Map Creator docking point: a fixed floor position where a carrier is parked at a station, with its heading, its operator-facing name and the bay it belongs to

schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

schema.description: the entity is one Map Creator docking point: a fixed floor position where a carrier is parked at a station, with its heading, its operator-facing name and the bay it belongs to

at_cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `dock_coordinate` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

at_cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `dock_coordinate` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

direction.description: Map Creator's `direction`, carried as the export states it.

display_name.description: Map Creator's `display_name`, carried as the export states it.

dock_barcode.description: Map Creator's `dock_barcode`, present only where it differs from the `id` it repeats in every row of every dump seen. Absent means the two agree and the export writes this one from the other.

docking_station_id.description: Map Creator's `station_id`, carried as the export states it.

runtime.description: What was happening at the site when the export was written, as the export wrote it. SPEC §1 separates a world from what is happening in it, so this is here to be dropped by a policy that decides to rather than lost by a converter that forgot — the round trip writes it back.

mtu_id.description: Map Creator's `mtu_id`, carried as the export states it.
